meta.title: Status Bar
meta.description: A living terminal strip in the composer dock: the running model with its family mark, a rotating status phrase, a token-flow lane (beads, heartbeat, water, a typing terminal line or highway traffic that grows with tok/s), the agent's checklist as step boxes, and real turns, token split, cache-hit and context figures. Twelve palettes, a click wave, and a settings page under Plugins.
